clean_repro.probe: Insert 10 rows, delete 5 rows (IDs 1-5), then search
clean_repro.observed: Delete succeeded (deleteCount=5), but search still returns all 10 rows including deleted IDs 1-5. API returns stale data after delete.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/create" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "test_stale_search", "dimension": 4}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/insert" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "test_stale_search", "data": [{"id": 0, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}, {"id": 1, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}, {"id": 2, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}, {"id": 3, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}, {"id": 4, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}]}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/load" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "test_stale_search", "dbName": "default"}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/delete" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "test_stale_search", "filter": "id in [1,2,3,4]", "dbName": "default"}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/search" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "test_stale_search", "data": [[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]], "limit": 10}'

contract_refs: Endpoint: entities+delete - Delete entities matching a filter expression (delete is irreversible)
Endpoint: entities+search - Search for nearest neighbors using vector embeddings
Expected behavior: After delete, search should not return deleted entities

source_grounding.source_excerpt: // entities+delete should mark entities as deleted; entities+search should filter deleted entities. The stale results suggest index bitmap not updated after delete or search not applying delete filter.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 handler_v2.go:delete() → proxy.Delete() → should update delete bitmap; REST v2 handler_v2.go:search() → proxy.Search() → should filter using delete bitmap
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:删除操作后搜索仍返回已删除实体,说明删除位图未正确更新或搜索未正确应用删除过滤。这是索引一致性问题。

falsification.probe: Query with filter to verify deleted rows status
falsification.observed: After delete, search should return only non-deleted rows. The fact that deleted IDs (1-5) still appear confirms stale index/data issue.

excluded: Request format error - valid delete and search calls

cognition_match.matched_pattern: blindspot_indicators[2] - Segment state machine violations; Snapshot isolation broken during concurrent operations
cognition_match.developer_quote: Delete must be immediately visible to search; stale search results are a data consistency bug

contract.explicit_requirement: entities+delete: delete is irreversible; entities+search should return current state

physical.objective_constraint: Deleted entities must not appear in search results - fundamental consistency requirement

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_A=CONFIRMED, verdict_B=CONFIRMED, verdict_C=CONFIRMED → final=CONFIRMED (stale data bug)

verdicts.rationale: entities+delete 操作成功(deleteCount=5)后,entities+search 仍返回包含已删除 ID (1-5) 的全部 10 行数据,是严重的数据一致性问题。这违反了数据库系统的基本不变量:删除操作必须立即可见于后续查询。问题可能根因包括:删除位图未正确更新、索引未及时刷新、或搜索操作未正确应用删除过滤。这属于段状态机违规和快照隔离破坏,与开发者认知盲点列表中的'Segment state machine violations'模式一致。这不是预期行为,而是需要修复的高优先级缺陷。
